english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “involved” means complicated or difficult to follow.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not simple or straightforward.
This is the all-purpose choice for something difficult, convoluted, or involving many interrelated parts.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for sophisticated systems or technology when the emphasis is on complexity.
This is the all-purpose choice for something complex, intricate, or difficult to follow.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something has many complicated or intricately arranged parts.
